blocks.text: The office reopens tomorrow on the normal schedule. The supply room was restocked over the break with toner, legal pads, and file folders; if you take the last of anything, note it on the sheet inside the door. The kitchen refrigerator was emptied before the holiday, so anything left in it is gone.

Last year's closed files are boxed in the file room for off-site storage. The boxes go out Friday, so pull anything you still need before then; the index is taped to the end of the shelf. Conference room bookings for January go on the shared calendar, not by email.
